H2 optimal output-feedback synthesis

Source: R/robust.R
ctrl_h2syn.Rd

Compute the controller minimizing the H2 norm of the closed loop \(T_{zw}\) for a continuous time generalized plant (see ctrl_lft()).

Usage

ctrl_h2syn(P, nmeas, ncon)

Arguments

P

Generalized plant.

nmeas, ncon

Numbers of measurements and controls.

Value

An object of class c("ctrl_synthesis", "ctrl_controller") with K (controller), closed_loop, norm (closed-loop H2 norm), X, Y and method.

Details

Assumptions (checked; violations raise errors): \(D_{11} = 0\) (so the closed-loop H2 norm is finite), \(D_{12}\) full column rank, \(D_{21}\) full row rank, \((A, B_2)\) stabilizable, \((C_2, A)\) detectable, and no invariant zeros of the \((A, B_2, C_1, D_{12})\) and \((A, B_1, C_2, D_{21})\) subsystems on the imaginary axis (detected as Riccati failures).

Algorithm. Two Riccati equations (Zhou, Doyle and Glover, 1996, Theorem 14.7): \(X_2\) = ctrl_care(A, B2, C1'C1, D12'D12, C1'D12), \(F_2 = -(D_{12}^\top D_{12})^{-1}(B_2^\top X_2 + D_{12}^\top C_1)\); \(Y_2\) = ctrl_care(A', C2', B1 B1', D21 D21', B1 D21'), \(L_2 = -(Y_2 C_2^\top + B_1 D_{21}^\top)(D_{21} D_{21}^\top)^{-1}\); the controller is \(A_K = A + B_2 F_2 + L_2 C_2\), \(B_K = -L_2\), \(C_K = F_2\), \(D_K = 0\) (with a loop shift when \(D_{22} \ne 0\)). The closed-loop H2 norm is computed independently with ctrl_norm() and returned.

References

Zhou, K., Doyle, J. C. and Glover, K. (1996). Robust and Optimal Control. Prentice Hall.

Examples

# LQG as an H2 problem: z = [x1; u], w = [process noise; sensor noise]
A <- matrix(c(0, 1, 0, 0), 2, byrow = TRUE)
P <- ctrl_ss(A, cbind(diag(2), 0, c(0, 1)),
             rbind(c(1, 0), c(0, 0), c(1, 0)),
             rbind(c(0, 0, 0, 0), c(0, 0, 0, 1), c(0, 0, 1, 0)))
h2 <- ctrl_h2syn(P, nmeas = 1, ncon = 1)
h2$norm
#> [1] 3.29439
